html:
The unit looks fine from the doorway. Then you open the oven, pull out the bottom drawer in the bathroom vanity and run a finger along the track of the sliding door, and you can tell exactly how the last tenant lived. That walk-through is where rental turnover cleaning in Greer starts for us, and it is the same walk-through a landlord or property manager should do before calling anyone.

This guide is written for people who own or manage rentals around Greer, from older houses near Downtown Greer and Trade Street to newer homes out toward GSP Airport and the BMW plant. It covers what a turnover clean should include, how to fit it into the days between tenants and how to keep results consistent across units.

What a turnover clean covers that a regular clean does not

A weekly or biweekly visit keeps a lived-in home tidy. A turnover is different: the home is empty, nothing is hiding the baseboards, and the next person will inspect every corner. Our move-in and move-out cleaning follows a fixed list, which is exactly what a property manager needs.

  • Inside and outside of every kitchen cabinet and drawer
  • Inside the refrigerator, freezer, oven and microwave
  • Range hood, stovetop and backsplash degreased
  • Toilet base, grout, glass and vanity interiors in every bathroom
  • Closet shelves, rods and floors
  • Baseboards, doors, door frames and light switches
  • Window sills, tracks and blinds
  • Floors vacuumed and mopped edge to edge

Because the list does not change, you can hand it to a tenant at move-in and use it again at move-out. Nobody argues about what "clean" meant.

The order that saves you a second visit

Most turnover problems are scheduling problems. A cleaner who arrives before the painter leaves will clean the same room twice. One who arrives after the next tenant has carried in boxes cannot get to the floors or the closets.

  1. Tenant moves out and returns keys.
  2. You or your maintenance contact does repairs, touch-up paint and any carpet work.
  3. The cleaning team comes in last, top to bottom, with the home still empty.
  4. You do the final inspection and photograph the unit.
  5. The next tenant gets the keys.

If a unit needs both a repaint and a full clean, tell us when you book. Fresh paint leaves specks on window glass and sills, and we would rather plan for that than discover it halfway through. For a unit that was left in rough shape, we may suggest a deep cleaning pass first, which we can discuss during the estimate.

Who handles what at a turnover

TaskUsually handled by
Wall repair, paint, carpet replacementMaintenance or a contractor
Appliance repairs, lock changesLandlord or property manager
Cabinets, appliance interiors, bathrooms, floors, baseboardsCleaning team
Hauling out left-behind furniture or trashLandlord or a hauling service
Final inspection and photosLandlord or property manager

Keeping this split clear matters. Cleaning teams clean; they do not haul couches to the curb. If a tenant left a lot behind, clear it before we arrive so the hours go into cleaning rather than moving things around.

Helping a deposit dispute before it starts

When a tenant disputes a deduction, the best defense is a record. A written checklist, dated photos before and after, and a cleaning invoice that lists what was done are far easier to stand behind than a general statement that the unit was dirty. Renters get the same benefit from the other side, which is why our guide to getting a security deposit back in Greer pairs well with this one. If you manage several units, send both documents to new tenants at move-in so expectations are set early.

How much does rental turnover cleaning cost in Greer?

We do not quote turnovers from a photo or a phone description, because two units with the same square footage can take very different amounts of time. These are the factors that decide it:

  • Size of the unit, in rooms and square feet
  • Condition the last occupant left it in
  • Appliances: the inside of the oven and fridge are included, but heavy grease adds time
  • Whether the unit is empty (faster) or still has furniture in it
  • Timing, since a tight turnover window may need a larger team

Building a repeatable routine across your units

If you own more than one rental, the real value comes from repetition. A team that has already seen your units knows where the previous tenants tend to miss things, and the checklist becomes a habit rather than a negotiation. Greer sits close to I-85, SC-14, SC-101 and US-29, so travel between units is short for us, and that helps when two move-outs land in the same week. If your properties extend toward Taylors, our team also covers move-out cleaning in Taylors.

A note on documentation: ask the team to leave the checklist with you after each visit, and keep it in the unit file next to your move-out photos. When a unit has a quirk, such as a hard-to-reach range hood or a bathroom fan that holds dust, we note it so the next turnover goes faster. Small habits like that are what separate a rental that always shows well from one that needs a scramble every time keys change hands.

Our team is Brazilian-owned and works detail first: baseboards by hand, door frames wiped, the tracks of sliding doors cleaned rather than skipped. That is the part inspectors and incoming tenants actually notice. Booking a week or two ahead is the easiest way to get your preferred day, and a quick call often works for shorter notice depending on the calendar.

faqs: How long does a rental turnover clean take in Greer?

It depends on the size of the unit and how it was left. An empty apartment moves faster than a furnished house, and heavy oven grease or bathroom buildup adds time. We confirm the schedule during the free in-home estimate.
Should the cleaning happen before or after repairs and painting?
After. Cleaners should come in once repairs, paint and carpet work are finished, so dust and paint specks are cleaned only once.
Can you clean several units for the same property manager?
Yes. Tell us how many units and the move-out dates, and we will plan the visits around your schedule. Each one still starts with a free estimate.
